Arrive in Santiago, Chile.

Your driver will meet you and take you to your hotel.

Once you’ve checked in, you’ll set out on a city tour.

Santiago lies in a valley surrounded by mountains. The old city centre is known for its colonial architecture, while newer districts lie towards the outskirts and business areas.

The first main stop is San Cristóbal Hill in Santiago Metropolitan Park. The statue of the Virgin Mary stands here, and the hill offers panoramic views of the city.

You’ll then continue to the historic centre.

You’ll see the Governor’s House, the main post office, La Moneda Palace, the main square and the Metropolitan Cathedral.

Plaza de Armas is also home to the opera and ballet theatre.

The final part of the tour takes you through modern Santiago, past hotels, restaurants, bars and shopping centres.

After the tour, you’ll return to your hotel.

You can also book a wine tour and tasting in the Maipo Valley for USD 230 per person, with a minimum of two participants.
